messages.subject: MatchIt version
messages.body_plain:
Hi;

<http://gking.harvard.edu/matchit/> shows the current version to be 2.4-2 
but I can only find version 2.3-1 on CRAN. Any ideas when the updated 
package will make it to the mirrors? I ask because I wanted to see "cem" in 
action.

Also, I've been unable to print beyond page 3 of the PDF version of the 
MatchIt manual (dated June 12, 2008). Adobe PreFlight check throws an error 
(error code 135). Perhaps an offending font or some thing?

best

Ani

Anirudh V. S. Ruhil, Ph.D.
Sr. Research Associate
The Voinovich School of Leadership & Public Affairs
Ohio University

messages.subject: Re: MatchIt version
messages.body_plain:
you can load them directly from my web page
before they make it to cran.  just do this:



install.packages("cem",repos="http://gking.harvard.edu")

install.packages("MatchIt",repos="http://gking.harvard.edu")



not sure what the problem is with printing, but it works for me.  maybe
someone else will have a suggestion.



Gary

---

http://gking.harvard.edu
